description: No source-page body was requested in this handoff. Exact-URL receipts for VOA/Homa and IranWire/Saravan were not usable at request time: the Homa manual-review receipt was followed by an immediate full-input recheck showing Hungary and Indonesia source-ledger hashes changed; a fresh Homa check deferred on a changed before/after fingerprint; two IranWire manual-review receipts each were followed by an immediate full-input recheck showing review/source_checks.jsonl changed.
